attribution.localizedCause: The reused fixture_identity function hardcodes the top_ff2_ probe prefix; it does not parameterize the prospectively declared probe namespace, so it compared top_ff1_ measurement files as production fixture outputs.

decision.rationale: Create an immutable manifest-accounting retry that does not rerun the teacher, enumerates the exact top_ff1 input/adjoint, 64-state, bin/meta probe population, requires all 512 stale mismatches to equal that set across two captures, and copies the sealed tensors byte-for-byte.

hypothesis.rationale: The sealed tensors support deterministic exact capture, but the frozen promotion contract cannot accept them until a manifest-only retry proves that every one of the 512 recorded mismatches is an expected probe path and that all non-probe fixture payloads are unchanged.

transferableLessons: Fixture identity must exclude an exact enumerated probe population owned by the experiment, then compare every remaining path by size and digest; a hardcoded historical probe prefix is not reusable accounting.
uncertainties: A sealed manifest-only correction must still prove the exact 256-file probe set in each capture and zero non-probe mismatch before the adjoint oracle can be promoted.

reasons: Both complete source captures, exact input comparison, live adjoint, and initial-matrix extraction succeeded, but the inherited fixture-identity helper excludes only top_ff2_ and therefore classified all 256 declared top_ff1_ probe files in each manifest as fixture mutations.
